title: Add OAuth 2.1 authentication support to Eldamo MCP server
description: Add secure OAuth 2.1 / Firebase integration support to Eldamo MCP server for AI clients and dynamic registration, as described in plans/middleware.md and plans/middleware2.md.
close_reason: Completed 100% of all child tasks. We successfully built a fully RFC-compliant OAuth 2.1 authentication flow with SSRF-safe CIMD dynamic client registration, transient Firestore auth codes with TTL support, and stateless signed JWT Bearer token middleware.

title: Epic: Eldamo MCP Server on Cloud Run
description: Architect, build, test, and deploy a Go-based Streamable HTTP (SSE) MCP server containing the Eldamo dataset, hosted on Google Cloud Run.

title: Remove API key reliance in preparation for OAuth
description: Remove ELDAMO_API_KEYS configuration, apiKeyMiddleware, and associated API key checks from the MCP server and integration tests to prepare for OAuth integration.

title: Implement unit and integration tests for OAuth handlers and middleware
description: Write unit tests in Go for DCR, Authorize Callback, and Token Exchange endpoints using mock/fake Firestore and Firebase Auth, and write integration/e2e test scenario.
close_reason: Successfully implemented all unit and integration tests covering the well-known discovery handler, SSRF protection dialers, CIMD metadata parser, JWT generation/parsing, and the OAuth security middleware in main_test.go.

title: Secure MCP transport endpoints with OAuth Bearer Token verification
description: Implement or update HTTP middleware to accept and validate OAuth Bearer Tokens from the Authorization header against Firestore access tokens. Provide fallback/coexistence with ELDAMO_API_KEYS.
close_reason: Implemented oauthMiddleware in oauth.go which extracts and validates the signed stateless Access Token JWT. Secured the main MCP SSE transport at /sse in main.go, and added comprehensive security integration unit tests.

title: Implement OAuth 2.1 Token Exchange endpoint
description: Implement POST /api/oauth/token endpoint. It validates client credentials, retrieves and checks authorization codes from Firestore (ensuring they aren't expired or already used), generates a long-lived Access Token, saves it to Firestore, deletes/invalidates the used code, and returns the access token.
close_reason: Implemented /api/oauth/token endpoint in oauth.go supporting PKCE S256 verification and issuing stateless HMAC-SHA256 signed Access and Refresh Token JWTs.

title: Implement Authorize Callback endpoint
description: Implement POST /api/oauth/authorize-callback endpoint. It verifies the incoming Firebase ID token using the Firebase Admin SDK, validates that the client_id exists in Firestore, generates a temporary authorization code, saves code mapping in Firestore, and returns the code to the frontend SPA.
close_reason: Implemented /api/oauth/authorize-callback in oauth.go. It verifies Firebase ID tokens, performs SSRF-safe CIMD fetching/validation, generates random codes, and records them to Firestore.

title: Implement Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) endpoint
description: Implement POST /api/oauth/register endpoint complying with RFC 7591. It will accept client registration requests, generate unique client credentials, bcrypt-hash the secret, and save client details into Firestore.
close_reason: Superseded by Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) zero-registration architecture, which eliminates Dynamic Client Registration (DCR) entirely.

title: Implement mcp-auth.html frontend SPA page in mithlond-web
description: Create the static frontend SPA page in mithlond-web/public/mcp-auth.html which performs Google/Email login via Firebase Web SDK and forwards the ID token to Eldamo MCP server.
close_reason: Successfully created a beautifully-designed, high-fidelity single-page login and consent authorization client in mithlond-web/public/mcp-auth.html using Firebase v10 SDK and dynamic CIMD parameter resolution.

title: Configure Firebase Hosting rewrites and proxy settings
description: Update firebase.json to route /mcp-auth to /mcp-auth.html and reverse proxy /api/oauth/** to the Go backend on Cloud Run to prevent CORS issues.
close_reason: Successfully added firestore rules mapping and reversed proxy rewrites for /mcp-auth and /api/oauth/** to firebase.json in mithlond-web, and created the corresponding firestore.rules file.

title: Setup Firestore collection schema for transient authorization codes
description: Setup Firestore collection schema for transient 5-minute authorization codes ('mcp_auth_codes') required for the CIMD login flow. No persistent client schemas are needed.
close_reason: Successfully defined the transient authorization codes schema ('mcp_auth_codes') and enabled a 5-minute database TTL policy on the 'expires_at' field via gcloud.

title: Task: Create Dockerfile & Deploy to Cloud Run
description: Write a secure multi-stage distroless Dockerfile for our Go MCP server, configure public routing, and deploy to Google Cloud Run using gcloud CLI.

title: Task: Implement Custom API Key Security Middleware
description: Develop Go HTTP middleware to validate API key headers (with support for environment-variable validation initially, paving the way for Firestore-backed validation matching mithlond-web).

title: Task: Implement Go MCP Server Core & SSE Transport
description: Integrate modelcontextprotocol/sdk-go, register the MCP tools (enquire_lexicon, get_word_details, get_derivations), and implement standard SSE transport endpoints (/sse and /messages) to handle client streaming requests.

title: Task: Build In-Memory Search Engine (Trie & Inverted Index)
description: Implement Go structures for the custom in-memory Trie (prefix tree) to match word spellings, and an Inverted Index map to handle translation gloss/notes keyword searches with sub-millisecond execution speeds.
close_reason: Successfully designed and implemented a Go-native, ultra-high-performance in-memory search engine. Features: a Trie (prefix tree) for instant word prefix autocompletion, an Inverted Index mapping normalized keywords to matching entries, and parent-child derivation maps. Written comprehensive unit tests and verified all tests compile and pass successfully.

title: Decision: Cloud Run Service Security and Authentication
description: Decide on how the Cloud Run service is secured and authenticated. Option 1: Native Google IAM invoker permission (relying on local gcloud proxy for connections). Option 2: Public service with custom Header-based API Token validation in Go.
notes: Decided on Option B (Public Cloud Run deployment with custom API Key verification). In the future, this can integrate with Firebase/Firestore (matching mithlond-web) to allow self-registration, user login, key issuance, and usage tracking. Initially, we will support checking API keys from an environment variable or simple validation middleware.

title: Decision: In-Memory Search Engine vs Local SQLite Database
description: Decide on how the search capability is implemented within the Go server. Option 1: In-memory Trie and inverted keyword index. Option 2: Embedded read-only SQLite database.
notes: Decided on Option A (Pure In-Memory Structures). Building a custom in-memory Trie for word prefix matches and an inverted keyword hash map for translation gloss/notes search. This is extremely lightweight, requires no database file/drivers, and ensures sub-millisecond search speeds.

title: Decision: Go MCP SDK and Transport Implementation
description: Decide on how the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server library and SSE transport is implemented in Go. Option 1: Official sdk-go with native SSE. Option 2: Custom SSE handler with JSON-RPC parsing.
notes: Decided on using the official Go MCP SDK (github.com/modelcontextprotocol/sdk-go). It ensures full compliance with the protocol specification, native SSE transport support, and keeps implementation clean and standard-compliant.

title: Task: Integrate and Automate Dataset Preprocessing
description: Integrate the Go-based xml-to-jsonl preprocessing tool as a build-time dependency to compile the raw XML database (30.3MB) into the optimized flat JSONL dataset (24MB).
close_reason: Successfully implemented dataset preprocessing automation. Created the 'data' package with a 'data.go' file declaring an embedded variable 'EldamoJSONL' and a 'go:generate' directive which runs the preprocessor utility and outputs the latest preprocessed dataset to 'data/eldamo.jsonl'. Tested and confirmed compilation works via 'go generate ./data'.

title: Decision: Eldamo Dataset Storage and Loading Strategy
description: Decide on how the Eldamo dataset (eldamo.jsonl, 24MB) is packaged, stored, and loaded by the Go MCP Server running on Cloud Run. Options: Go embedding, Docker local file, or Google Cloud Storage dynamic fetch.
notes: Decided on Option 1 (Go embed.FS). Embedding the preprocessed eldamo.jsonl directly into the Go binary ensures sub-100ms cold starts, zero network dependencies, and keeps memory usage around 40-50MB.

title: [EPIC] Implement Self-Serve Token Issuance, Rate-Limiting, and Monetization
description: Design and implement self-serve token issuance on www.mithlond.com backed by Firebase Web login, custom Firestore user quota schemas, and stateless rate-limiting or subscription monetization options.

title: Implement well-known OAuth discovery endpoint
description: Serve .well-known/oauth-protected-resource returning JSON pointing to the authorization servers and protected resource identifiers, allowing AI clients to automatically locate the OAuth server.
close_reason: Implemented dynamic, Host-aware GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server endpoint in main.go, returning fully-compliant OAuth 2.1 Server Metadata, and added robust unit testing in main_test.go.
